stories.headline: Broadcom Signs Deal to Produce Google TPUs Through 2031, Expands Anthropic Compute to 3.5 GW

key_facts.fact: Broadcom agreed to produce future versions of Google's AI chips and provide networking equipment for next-gen AI data racks through 2031, per SEC filing
key_facts.excerpt: Broadcom said Monday that it's agreed to produce future versions of artificial intelligence chips for Google, and signed an expanded deal with Anthropic

key_facts.fact: Anthropic will receive approximately 3.5 gigawatts of next-generation TPU-based computing capacity starting in 2027
key_facts.excerpt: signed an expanded deal with Anthropic that will give the AI startup access to about 3.5 gigawatts worth of computing capacity drawing on Google's AI processors

key_facts.fact: Anthropic's run-rate revenue surpassed $30 billion, up from approximately $9 billion at the end of 2025
key_facts.excerpt: Our run-rate revenue has now surpassed $30 billion—up from approximately $9 billion at the end of 2025

key_facts.fact: Over 1,000 business customers now spending more than $1 million annually on Claude, doubling from February in less than two months
key_facts.excerpt: over 500 business customers were each spending over $1 million on an annualized basis. Today that number exceeds 1,000, doubling in less than two months

key_facts.fact: Mizuho analysts estimated Broadcom would pick up $21 billion in AI revenue from Anthropic in 2026 and $42 billion in 2027
key_facts.excerpt: analysts at Mizuho led by Vijay Rakesh estimated that Broadcom would pick up $21 billion in AI revenue from Anthropic in 2026 and $42 billion in 2027

key_facts.fact: Vast majority of new compute will be sited in the US, expanding Anthropic's November 2025 commitment to invest $50 billion in American computing infrastructure
key_facts.excerpt: The vast majority of the new compute will be sited in the United States, making this partnership a major expansion of our November 2025 commitment to invest $50 billion in strengthening American computing infrastructure

key_facts.fact: Broadcom shares rose 3% in extended trading following the announcement
key_facts.excerpt: Shares of Broadcom rose 3% in extended trading

stories.headline: Samsung Posts Record Q1 Profit of 57.2T Won, Up 755% YoY on AI Memory Supercycle

key_facts.fact: Samsung Electronics reported record Q1 operating profit of 57.2 trillion won (~$38B), up 755% from 6.69 trillion won a year earlier
key_facts.excerpt: preliminary operating profit for the January-March period reached 57.2 trillion won ($38 billion)... Operating profit jumped 755 percent from 6.69 trillion won a year earlier

key_facts.fact: Revenue rose 68.1% YoY to 133 trillion won, exceeding 100 trillion won for the first time in Samsung's history
key_facts.excerpt: revenue of 133 trillion won... revenue rose 68.1 percent from 79.14 trillion won... Quarterly revenue topped the 100 trillion won mark for the first time

key_facts.fact: Q1 operating profit alone exceeded Samsung's full-year 2025 earnings of 43.6 trillion won and nearly tripled the previous quarterly record of 20 trillion won set in Q4 2025
key_facts.excerpt: The record-high results nearly triple Samsung's previous record quarterly operating profit of 20 trillion won, reached in the fourth quarter last year

key_facts.fact: Results came in 36.7% higher than the average market estimate, marking one of Samsung's largest earnings surprises on record
key_facts.excerpt: The operating profit was 36.7 percent higher than the average estimate, according to a survey by Yonhap Infomax

key_facts.fact: DRAM contract prices rose 90-95% QoQ in Q1 and are projected to climb another 50-60% in Q2, according to TrendForce
key_facts.excerpt: DRAM prices rose 90-95 percent in the first quarter from the previous quarter and are projected to climb another 60 percent in the second quarter

key_facts.fact: Chip division estimated to have generated 54 trillion won in operating profit, accounting for 95% of Samsung's total
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung's chip division generated 54 trillion won in operating profit, accounting for 95 per cent of its total profit

key_facts.fact: Korea Investment & Securities projects Samsung's annual operating profit could reach 302 trillion won in 2026
key_facts.excerpt: Korea Investment & Securities Co. suggesting an annual operating profit of 302 trillion won, up 50 percent from the previous outlook

stories.headline: Intel in Talks With Google and Amazon for Advanced EMIB Chip Packaging Services

key_facts.fact: Intel has been in ongoing discussions with Google and Amazon to provide advanced chip packaging services through its Foundry division, per Wired citing multiple sources
key_facts.excerpt: Intel has been in ongoing talks with Google (GOOGL) and Amazon (AMZN) about using its advanced packaging services, according to a report from Wired citing multiple sources

key_facts.fact: Intel's EMIB and EMIB-T packaging technology is positioned as a more power-efficient and cost-effective alternative to TSMC's CoWoS, which is severely supply-constrained
key_facts.excerpt: Intel's EMIB and EMIB-T packaging tech is pitched as more power-efficient and cost-effective than TSMC's approach

key_facts.fact: EMIB-T is set to roll out in Intel fabs this year, with mass production already being prepared at the Rio Rancho, New Mexico facility
key_facts.excerpt: EMIB-T is set to roll out in fabs this year, with mass production already being prepared in Rio Rancho, New Mexico

key_facts.fact: Intel Foundry chief Naga Chandrasekaran said a rise in capital expenditure will be the clearest signal that major customers have signed on
key_facts.excerpt: Intel's Foundry chief says a jump in capital expenditure will be the clearest sign that major customers have signed on

key_facts.fact: Intel executives say packaging revenue could reach well north of $1 billion and eventually run into multi-billion-dollar annual deals
key_facts.excerpt: executives say packaging revenue could reach well north of $1 billion and eventually run into multi‑billion-dollar deals

key_facts.fact: Potential customers are cautious, worried Intel may not deliver on expansion promises or that TSMC could cut their wafer allocations in response
key_facts.excerpt: Potential customers are reportedly cautious, worried Intel may not deliver on expansion promises or that TSMC could cut their wafer allocations in response

stories.headline: Nvidia-Backed Firmus Raises $505M at $5.5B Valuation for Asia-Pacific AI Data Centers

key_facts.fact: Australian AI infrastructure startup Firmus raised $505 million led by Coatue Management with Nvidia participation, at a $5.5 billion post-money valuation
key_facts.excerpt: Data center builder Firmus Technologies Pty raised $505 million in an investment round led by Coatue Management LLC... The deal values the Australian startup at $5.5 billion

key_facts.fact: Firmus has raised $1.35 billion in the last six months, including this latest transaction, and is preparing for an ASX IPO later this year
key_facts.excerpt: This marks Firmus' third equity raise in six months, bringing total capital raised during that period to $1.35 billion... The funding arrives as the company prepares for a much-anticipated initial public offering on the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX) later this year

key_facts.fact: Project Southgate aims to build a network of AI data centers across Australia with capacity up to 1.6 gigawatts over the next three years, in collaboration with Nvidia and CDC Data Centres
key_facts.excerpt: Project Southgate initiative... aims to build a network of AI factories across Australia... expected to reach a capacity of up to 1.6 gigawatts over the next three years

key_facts.fact: Tasmania facility will house 36,000 Nvidia accelerator chips after first two rounds of technology deployments, using Nvidia's Vera Rubin DSX reference design
key_facts.excerpt: That facility will house computers based on 36,000 Nvidia accelerator chips after its first two rounds of technology deployments... Firmus is using Vera Rubin DSX, a design provided by Nvidia for building what it calls AI factories

key_facts.fact: Also backed by Blackstone, which extended $10 billion in debt financing in February
key_facts.excerpt: The company is also backed by Blackstone (NYSE: BX), which in February extended $10 billion in debt financing

key_facts.fact: Firmus has already deployed facilities in Singapore through a partnership with ST Telemedia Global Data Centres, backed by Temasek
key_facts.excerpt: Firmus has already deployed facilities in Singapore through a partnership with ST Telemedia Global Data Centres, backed by Temasek and plans to scale further across Southeast Asia

stories.headline: Taiwan Intelligence: China Targeting Island's Chip Tech and Talent to Break 'Containment'

key_facts.fact: Taiwan's National Security Bureau report to lawmakers says China is attempting to 'lure' Taiwan's AI and semiconductor industries to establish operations in China
key_facts.excerpt: Taiwan's National Security Bureau said that China is attempting to 'lure' Taiwan's high-tech industries, including AI and semiconductors, to establish or retain operations in China

key_facts.fact: China using indirect channels to poach talent, steal technology, and procure controlled goods to obtain advanced-process chips and break 'international technological containment'
key_facts.excerpt: It also continues to use indirect channels to poach Taiwanese talent, steal technology, and procure controlled goods, with the aim of obtaining key core technologies and products such as Taiwan's advanced-process chips, thereby breaking through international technological containment

key_facts.fact: 11 new mainland Chinese firms were put under investigation by Taiwan's Ministry of Justice Investigation Bureau for illegally poaching semiconductor talent
key_facts.excerpt: A total of 11 new mainland Chinese firms were put under investigation for allegedly poaching semiconductor and other hi-tech talent, according to Taiwan's Ministry of Justice Investigation Bureau

key_facts.fact: 100 cases of Chinese talent poaching have been handled by Taiwan's MJIB since 2020, including a probe into SMIC last year
key_facts.excerpt: The latest probes are part of Taiwan's ongoing crackdown on mainland Chinese talent poaching, with 100 cases handled since 2020

key_facts.fact: Taiwan's Government Service Network was targeted by more than 170 million intrusion attempts in Q1 2026
key_facts.excerpt: Taiwan's Government Service Network was targeted by more than 170 million intrusion attempts in the first quarter of this year

key_facts.fact: Over 420 Chinese military aircraft were detected operating around Taiwan in Q1, with 10 joint combat readiness patrols
key_facts.excerpt: more than 420 Chinese military aircraft were detected operating around Taiwan, and Chinese naval vessels coordinated with them in carrying out 10 'joint combat readiness patrols'
